features.title: Duplicate pairs review modal in Images page
acceptance: Detect Duplicates button shows a modal with side-by-side thumbnails of canonical and duplicate images
Modal displays filename, dimensions, and format for each image in the pair
Duplicate images are marked with a 'Duplicate' badge
Modal can be closed with 'Got it' button or backdrop click

features.title: Fetch full image details for all duplicate pairs in modal
acceptance: Duplicate pairs modal shows thumbnails and metadata for ALL detected pairs, not just those on the current page
Modal fetches complete image records for all pair images via API before displaying

acceptance: Run checks, fix failures, and implement the next planned feature
